title: Fumipoka
shortDescription: Save your place in a project, keep notes and return to your next small step.
fullDescription:
Fumipoka — a quiet little everyday companion.

Keep projects, missions, dependencies, references and Save Point checkpoints together. Write what you finished, where you stopped and the next action to take. Focus Studio and Rescue Mode help you return to work. Example notebooks are opt-in, marked as samples and removable. JSON exports include project history and preferences.

Make it your own with light, dark, system and OLED appearances, selectable color palettes and a custom accent. Some accent tones are adjusted for readability. Japanese-designed fonts and original café illustrations bring a little warmth to the everyday interface.

Free forever. No advertisements, subscriptions, paid features, accounts, AI or tracking SDKs. Core features work offline and personal records stay in private storage on this device. Automatic Android cloud backup is disabled. You control exports: files are unencrypted, and the document provider you choose may store them in the cloud. Keep a private backup before moving to a new device.

Android may delay reminders to protect battery life; notification permission and system settings affect delivery.

Formerly Returnmark. The existing Android package and supported backup formats are retained.
